reasoning_content: Now I'm searching through the FeatureTypeList to identify the specific type names.

python3 -c "
import re
d=open('/tmp/caps52.xml').read()
i=d.find('<FeatureTypeList>')
j=d.find('</FeatureTypeList>')
seg=d[i:j]
names=re.findall(r'<TypeName[^>]*>([^<]+)</TypeName>',seg)
print('count',len(names)); print(names[:8])
"
